C1623.title: AI-Cloned Voice Used to Create Fake Songs Impersonating Artist
C1623.summary: In 2026, attackers used AI to clone a female artist's voice, generating cover songs and uploading them to major streaming platforms under her name. AI detection tools determined the songs were likely AI-generated. The artist expressed shock and frustration, stating, 'It's a computer imitating my voice.'

references.title: Woman Finds AI-Cloned Voice Used in Fake Song, Attempts to Assert Rights but Gets Hit with AI-Generated Infringement Claim
